best_idea: Show each combatant's health change since a snapshot taken at a chosen point in the exchange, as a signed percent on its bar, and make regeneration move the snapshot too so it never reads as a change.
decision_why: Useful on the enemy target frame: a signed change over the exchange plus a once-per-crossing alert reads at a glance. The donor's snapshot point is after the player's own action, so the readout would hide our hit; we choose the window and take the snapshot before our action is resolved. Donor regen gate defect (Time.c:2287, 2294) fixed in the sketch.
acceptance: On the target frame at 375 wide, after an exchange containing our hit and an enemy hit back, the enemy label reads Health (-30%) for the whole exchange; a passive regen tick leaves the label unchanged; a server test asserts the snapshot is taken before our action resolves and that regen moves the snapshot by the same amount.
